    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AdminController
    Handles the admin subsystem.
    Album
    Represents one album belonging to a user.
    AlbumController
    Controls the screen for one open album.
    AppState
    Represents the full saved state of the application.
    DataStore
    Handles reading and writing the serialized data file.
    DialogUtils
    Small helper class for common JavaFX dialogs.
    FormatUtils
    Utility methods for turning dates and metadata into readable text.
    ImageUtils
    Helper methods for loading images into JavaFX controls.
    LoginController
    Handles the login screen.
    Photo
    Represents a photo in the user's library.
    PhotoLibraryService
    Central service layer for the application.
    PhotoListCell
    Custom list cell used to display a photo preview in list views.
    Photos
    Main JavaFX application class for the photo manager.
    ScreenController
    Shared interface for controllers that need access to the main application.
    SearchController
    Handles the photo search screen.
    SearchMode
    Describes the two search modes supported by the application.
    Tag
    Represents one tag attached to a photo.
    TagSearchOperator
    Lists the operators used when searching by tags.
    TagType
    Represents one tag type a user can work with, such as location or person.
    User
    Represents one user account in the application.
    UserHomeController
    Controls the main album screen for a normal user.
